President Bola Tinubu has commended the Jigawa State Government under Governor Umar Namadi, for its efforts in delivering democratic dividends to the people. The President who spoke during the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Dutse, the State capital, officially commissioned some projects executed by the Namadi administration.
The projects include two vocational training centres, namely the Bola Ahmed Tinubu Skills Acquisition Centre in Limawa and the Renewed Hope Technical Training Centre, designed to promote entrepreneurship and empower youth. Additionally, he commissioned the dualised Garu road leading to the palace of the Emir of Dutse to improve transportation.
He also commissioned 400 tractors, 150 combine harvesters, 150 planters/seeders, and other agricultural equipment that were procured to operate through 60 service centres across the state’s 30 constituencies.
While acknowledging the governor’s commitment to the development of the state, Mr Tinubu appealed to the people to support his re-election for a second term come January 2027.
